sentences.text: Robert Nesta Marley , OM -LRB- 6 February 1945 -- 11 May 1981 -RRB- was a Jamaican singer-songwriter , musician and guitarist who achieved international fame and acclaim , blending mostly reggae , ska and rocksteady in his compositions .	OM	Jamaican Order of Merit	ska	ska	rocksteady	rocksteady	singer-songwriter	singer-songwriter	reggae	reggae
Starting out in 1963 with the group the Wailers , he forged a distinctive songwriting and vocal style that would later resonate with audiences worldwide .	the Wailers	Bob Marley and the Wailers
The Wailers would go on to release some of the earliest reggae records with producer Lee `` Scratch '' Perry .	reggae	reggae

After the Wailers disbanded in 1974 , Marley pursued a solo career upon his relocation to England that culminated in the release of the album Exodus in 1977 , which established his worldwide reputation and elevated his status as one of the world 's best-selling artists of all time , with sales of more than 75 million records .	the Wailers	Bob Marley and the Wailers	Exodus	Exodus (Bob Marley & the Wailers album)
Exodus stayed on the British album charts for 56 consecutive weeks .	Exodus	Exodus (Bob Marley & the Wailers album)

It included four UK hit singles : `` Exodus '' , `` Waiting in Vain '' , `` Jamming '' , and `` One Love '' .	Exodus	Exodus (Bob Marley & the Wailers album)	Waiting in Vain	Waiting in Vain	Jamming	Jamming (song)	One Love	One Love/People Get Ready
In 1978 , he released the album Kaya , which included the hit singles `` Is This Love '' and `` Satisfy My Soul '' .	Kaya	Kaya (album)	Is This Love	Is This Love (Bob Marley & The Wailers song)
Diagnosed with acral lentiginous melanoma in 1977 , Marley died on 11 May 1981 in Miami at age 36 .	Miami	Miami	melanoma	melanoma	acral lentiginous melanoma	acral lentiginous melanoma
He was a committed Rastafari who infused his music with a sense of spirituality .	Rastafari	Rastafari
He is credited with popularising reggae music around the world and served as a symbol of Jamaican culture and identity .	reggae	reggae
Marley has also evolved into a global symbol and inspired numerous items of merchandise .
